title: Administrator
description:
Administrator Birchwood 13.50ph Temporary (3-6 months)

Forrest Recruitment are currently working with a well-established Home Builders based in Warrington. They are currently hiring for a temporary Customer Care Administrator to join their team.

Key duties of the role:
- Distributing defect reports to site teams and monitoring progress.
- Following up on outstanding defects throughout the week, including those identified during the Monday review.
- Liaising with contractors to obtain updates and ensure timely resolution of issues.
- Logging snagging lists accurately to support the wider team.
- Ensuring compliance by checking that all required documentation is uploaded and maintained within the system.
- Providing telephone cover when required, including taking messages during periods of low staffing, such as lunchtime.
- Offering general administrative support to the team, including covering duties during coordinators' annual leave and other absences.

For further information about this opportunity please call Katie at Forrest Recruitment for a confidential discussion on (phone number removed)

Alternatively, please forward your CV for immediate consideration, I look forward to hearing from you.

Please note that due to the high volume of applications we receive, only those successfully shortlisted for the role will be personally contacted.

title: Call Centre Operator - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 05/10/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Business Support Officer
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Business Support Officer
Warrington (Office-Based, 5 Days per Week)
£15.28 per hour + holiday pay
6-Month Temporary Assignment
I'm currently recruiting for a Business Support Officer to join the Asset Management team of a well-established housing organisation in Warrington.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced administrator who enjoys working with data, systems and reporting, and is confident supporting a busy operational team.
What you'll be doing:
- Managing and monitoring team inboxes
- Maintaining accurate records and databases
- Producing reports and working with data using Excel
- Using VLOOKUPs, formulas and Mail Merge as part of day-to-day tasks
- Supporting compliance-related administration and documentation
- Coordinating information across multiple systems
- Responding to customer enquiries and supporting service requests
- Assisting with complaint investigations through information gathering and record management
- Providing general administrative support to the wider Asset Management team

What I'm looking for:
- Strong administration experience within a busy office environment
- Advanced Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs and formulas
- Experience using Mail Merge
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word and Outlook
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
- A customer-focused approach and confident communication skills

Desirable:
- Experience working within social housing, property, repairs, compliance or asset management
- An understanding of housing compliance or regulatory requirements
- Business Administration NVQ Level 3

The Details:
£15.28 per hour + holiday pay Full-time, office-based role Central Warrington location 6-month temporary assignment September Start

title: Contribution Co-Ordinator
description:
We have an excellent opportunity for an experience Project Co-Ordinator to join Cheshire Police at Runcorn Town Hall to work as a Contribution Co-Ordinator.

This is a temporary ongoing position working Monday to Friday 37 hours a week.

Purpose of this role - To scale up the successful 'Cheshire Contribution' pilot projects that have revitalized green open spaces across the county, providing a practical invitation for people seeking asylum to visibly contribute to the communities they are temporarily calling home and for those communities to see that contribution first-hand.

The pilots, delivered in partnership with local residents, have received strong public support and demonstrated the value of collaborative, high-impact improvements to outdoor environments. The postholder will lead the countywide rollout of these initiatives, co-ordinating events and convening relevant partners and audiences to develop social cohesion, meaningful change and foster community engagement through volunteering and co-design.

Role Accountabilities
- Coordinate the Cheshire Contribution ensuring an efficient process is in place, including on-site management to ensure successful completion of tasks on the day of events
- Create an operational guide including checklists, safety protocols, risk assessments inductions and ensure all necessary equipment to complete the tasks is available
- Undertake the planning, delivery and co-ordination of events, including the development of marketing materials, for those taking part to ensure successful attraction of suitable stakeholders, local communities and volunteers
- Recruit volunteers and local residents to undertake individual projects, identify trusted local hosts and convenors who can support activity on the ground and ensure ongoing liaison throughout the period of the work
- Work with partnerships such as the local authorities, public bodies and other organisations to co-create projects in high impact, high visibility locations.
- Build and maintain a good relationship across the partnership landscape to identify appropriate projects to undertake and involve all relevant parties as well as unlocking the resources, capacity and relationships required
- Act as the single point of contact for the 'Cheshire Contribution' programme, providing advice to those wishing to participate as well as those agencies wishing to support
- Working closely with the Comms team, promote and build awareness of the programme engaging with stakeholders, delivering briefings to appropriate audiences and ensuring effective utilisation of volunteers
- Produce reports on the effectiveness of the programme including numbers involved and positive case studies and liaise with Comms to push out key messaging to not only promote the work but with a view to supporting community cohesion
- Maintain an understanding of community cohesion issues, identifying new opportunities to develop and expand the project
- Assist in the development, maintenance and implementation of a Cheshire contribution policy and look to mainstream the work into that of the OPCC and wider partners

Experience, Qualifications & Skills

Prior Education and Experience
- Educated to Level 4 or equivalent relevant experience
- Significant experience of coordinating events & activities.
- Experience of working with volunteers.

Skills
- Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Applications
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with those internal and external to the organisation.
- Excellent planning and organisation skills.
- You must hold a full UK driving licence and have access to a vehicle

title: Contact Centre Agent - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 05/10/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Appointments Clerk (Higher Level)
company: North Cheshire and Mersey NHS Foundation Trust (WHH)
advertiser_name: North Cheshire and Mersey NHS Foundation Trust (WHH)
description: Previous applicants need not apply The role of an Appointments Clerk (Higher Level) is varied and you will have many different responsibilities ranging from booking appointments and maintaining clinic templates to validating patients to ensure the appropriate outcome. You will be guided by a Team Supervisor who will provide support and leadership daily. You will be responsible for ensuring a smooth and efficient booking process for patients within the guidelines of following Trust policies. The Outpatients Appointments Team consists of a Booking Team, Reception and a Contact Centre. We are a dynamic and varied team, committed to providing excellent patient experience and delivering high quality patient care. The Booking Teams are based in a large, busy open plan office, and each team is responsible for different specialties. Our teams have a strong worth ethic and provide support to each other during busy and high-pressure situations. Please note that if you require a Visa to work in the UK, this post will not be eligible for a Certificate of Sponsorship. The main duties of an Appointments Clerk (Higher Level) is to maintain clinic templates, record referrals and appoint patients appropriately and in line with identified timescales and provide comprehensive administrative support to the specialties associated to each Appointments team. The successful candidate will be expected to accurately deliver administrative responsibilities within a focused and demanding environment. Management of clinical sessions is required at this level and includes setting up, maintenance, cancelling and reducing in line with Directorate/Departmental rotas. The role involves working as part of a team administering appointments in line with Trust policies and procedures, ensuring referrals are processed effectively using systems in place and ensuring patient access targets are met. FULL JOB DESCRIPTION ATTACHED

With previous experience in a similar role, and good organisational, communication and time management skills, you can enjoy a long and rewarding career, where a range of training opportunities are available that can see your career grow and career aspirations achieved. The administrator will play a crucial role in maintaining both electronic and paper files, ensuring smooth operations within the centre. A minimum of one year of experience in a similar HR role is desirable, alongside skills in organisation, communication, and time management. The role offers opportunities for career growth and development through various training programs. Additionally, the role requires the management of induction processes for new starters and the processing of HR matters such as leavers, maternity, and compliance checks. Rehabilitation and recovery at Arbury Court focus on care being ‘person-centred’ as opposed to ‘disease-centred’. Elysium Healthcare is part of Ramsay Health Care with a global network that extends across 10 countries and employs over 86,000 people globally. title: Medical Receptionist
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a full time medical receptionist of a busy General Practice. The role involves the post holder to work on a rotational basis between the hours of 8.00am - 6.30pm Mon- Friday (week 1: 8.00am - 4.00pm / week 2: 10.30pm-6.30pm) The post holder will provide a first point of contact for patients and act as a point of communication between patients, doctors and other medical staff. Provide general assistance to the practice team and provide efficient, helpful and supportive reception and administration services to patients and members of the primary health care team. Holder of the post should have a recognised qualification or good working knowledge of Microsoft Office Word and Excel, excellent communication skills, be able to work to deadlines, under pressure and be able to work on their own and as part of a team. Experience in EMIS web, Docman and ICE system is desirable but not essential as full training will be provided. We offer 27 days annual leave exclusive of bank holidays and enrolement to the NHS Pension. We intend to interview on Friday 4th September 2026 Applicants who have already applied for this vacancy will not be considered and need not apply again
